{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Filter out the 6 QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
df = df[df['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Do NOT filter out refunded orders — the question asks for the entire sales data
# Only exclude rows where customer_age is -1 (missing data)
df = df[df['customer_age'] != -1]

# Now compute the mean age of customers in the entire cleaned dataset (all rows, including refunded)
mean_age = df['customer_age'].mean()

# Also compute the number of valid rows
n_valid = len(df)

print(mean_age)
print(n_valid)"}
